headline: Public hearing on Special Permit and Site Plan #26-1405 for an art gallery at 131 Leeder Hill Drive, Unit 7.
summary: Residents can comment on the art gallery proposal at 131 Leeder Hill Drive. Also on the agenda are a $26,925.75 bond release for 20 Davis Street and a donation of native plants to Eli's Garden of Healing.
